rs2 - an OS/2 Warp 4.52 compatible operating system written in Rust
====================================================================

This disc boots on UEFI computers (and virtual machines). It starts a
live system with the rs2 command interpreter.

To install rs2 on a hard disk, type INSTALL at the command prompt. The
installer erases the chosen disk, creates an EFI system partition and
copies the system to it. Remove the disc and restart afterwards.

Programs for OS/2 (16-bit NE and 32-bit LX executables) can be run from
the command line. Many system services are still being written; see the
project's ROADMAP for the current state.
